headline: Autodesk acquires architect software firm Spacemaker for $240 million
summary: Autodesk Inc <ADSK.O> on Tuesday said it acquired Spacemaker, a Norwegian firm whose software is used by architects to create and evaluate buildings or urban developments, for $240 million.
